title: Predicting postoperative rehemorrhage in hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage using noncontrast CT radiomics and clinical data with an interpretable machine learning approach
summary: An SVM radiomics model predicted postoperative rehemorrhage in 609 patients and was checked in an external verification cohort; this was retrospective prediction, not evidence of clinical benefit.
ai_technology: SVM radiomics model for postoperative rehemorrhage

evidence.unknown: The external verification remained retrospective; prospective use and improved patient outcomes were not established.
